operator_io_quirks: Table 'Acceptance' has mixed case; must be double-quoted in generated SQL.
Column names mixed case (Workshop_ID, Submission_ID, Date, Name, Scores, Result); case-insensitive lookup needed.
DDL uses backtick-quoted parent refs (`submission`, `workshop`) inside FK clauses; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
All columns notnull=0 despite being PKs; sqlite PK implies NOT NULL only for INTEGER PK, so composite PK Acceptance allows NULLs in principle.
Date column declared TEXT but stores 'August 18, 2007' style dates; TS dispatches to String fuzzer, not Date.
Scores declared REAL, storage real, values like 72.0; Number fuzzer with scale from 'real' (no args) -> default scale.
Workshop_ID / Submission_ID declared INT with no args; Number fuzzer is_int=True, scale default.
Acceptance composite PK (Submission_ID, Workshop_ID); both are also FKs to distinct parents.
FK parent tables exist and are unique on parent col; no dangling FKs, no self-references.
Tiny tables (6, 10, 6 rows); original_values fully read, no sampling cap hit.
Result column has only 2 distinct values ('Accepted','Rejected'); String fuzzer will not preserve this enum.
Venue/College/Author are free text with spaces and parentheses ('Miami (OH)'); String fuzzer charset includes space and parens.
operator_ts_expectations: Date column: String fuzzer with length range from samples (~15 chars), produces random a-zA-Z0-9() strings, not dates -> queries filtering on date format will miss (FN).
Result column: String fuzzer produces random strings, so 'Result = Accepted' predicates rarely match -> FN on enum-like filters.
Venue/College/Author: random strings; joins/group-bys on these produce implausible values -> FN for value-specific queries.
Workshop_ID/Submission_ID: Number fuzzer with int perturbation (+-1,+-2) around sampled values; small range so collisions and near-duplicates likely.
Scores: Number fuzzer float perturbation +-0.01/+-0.02; range from scale, may exceed [72,89] -> FP for range predicates.
Acceptance FK columns drawn from parent final values with replacement; composite PK dedup drops duplicate (Sub,Work) pairs -> ties reduced.
PK dedup on workshop/submission keeps first occurrence; with small n, distinct counts shrink -> missing ties (FP on COUNT DISTINCT).
String fuzzer contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop) makes 'ABC 2007' style names unlikely to recur -> FN on LIKE 'ABC%'.
No NOT NULL enforcement: NULLs may appear in PK columns of Acceptance (composite) -> queries with IS NULL may fire (FP).
Table sizes: level-based or rand_lin; with 3 tables and 2 FK levels, sizes small (1+30u, x4) -> few rows, weak coverage.
Date strings like 'August 18, 2007' contain commas; String fuzzer charset lacks comma -> format never reproduced (FN).
Number fuzzer list_max quirk: upper bound overwritten to full range, so fresh draws span [-10^scale,10^scale] -> implausible IDs (FN).
